explanation:
[EFFECT] The holiday feature produces a clear step-change effect: on regular (non-holiday) days, the contribution is essentially neutral, sitting right at zero. On public holidays, the contribution drops sharply to about −0.145 in log space, which translates to roughly a 13–14% reduction in predicted bike rentals. There is no gradual transition — it is an all-or-nothing switch between the two values.

[IMPORTANCE] This is the least important feature in the model, ranked 9th out of 9 with an importance score of just 0.008. Its influence on predicted demand is small compared to factors like hour of the day or temperature.

[RECOMMENDATION] Since holidays slightly but consistently reduce overall demand, consider scaling back bike availability and staffing modestly on public holidays — though the effect is minor enough that other factors (like weather or time of day) should take priority in planning decisions.
